events.verdict: As Fox (SAC) moves laterally away from Randle (MIN), he reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball. When Randle regains control of the ball, Fox reaches in again and any arm contact that occurs is marginal.
Gobert (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position during Monk's (SAC) drive to the basket.
Fox (SAC) legally contests Edwards's (MIN) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
DeRozan (SAC) releases the ball prior to stepping out of bounds.
Sabonis (SAC) and DiVincenzo (MIN) mutually grab each other during the screen, but the contact quickly dissolves and both players are able to move freely.
DiVincenzo (MIN) lowers his arm and initiates more-than-marginal contact to Monk's (SAC) arm during his driving shot attempt.

As Sabonis (SAC) attempts to move around DiVincenzo (MIN) when the two players engage, he inadvertently makes contact to DiVincenzo's face with his forearm.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Murray (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position during Edwards' (MIN) drive to the basket.
Sabonis (SAC) initiates contact across Gobert's (MIN) arm during his upward shooting motion, affecting his shot attempt.
Replay review of the out of bounds called on Fox (SAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. The ball is last touched by Fox prior to it going out of bounds.
Sabonis (SAC) moves to imminently guard an opponent within three seconds.
Sabonis (SAC) lowers his arm and initiates illegal contact to Edwards' (MIN) face, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Edwards (MIN) contests the jump shot attempt by Murray (SAC) and avoids making any illegal contact.
